import html # Template for a user post (placeholder names in {curly braces}) USER_POST_FORMAT = ( '
\n' '

{post_title}

\n' '

Posted by: {username}

\n' '
{post_body}
\n' '

Tags: {tags_html}

\n' '
' ) def render_user_post(username: str, post_title: str, post_body: str, tags: list[str]) -> str: """ Render a user-generated forum post safely for HTML output. Parameters ---------- username : str The name of the user who created the post. post_title : str The title of the post. post_body : str The main content of the post. tags : list[str] A list of tags added by the user. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string representing the post. Raises ------ TypeError If any argument is not of the expected type. """ # Validate input types if not isinstance(username, str): raise TypeError("username must be a string") if not isinstance(post_title, str): raise TypeError("post_title must be a string") if not isinstance(post_body, str): raise TypeError("post_body must be a string") if not isinstance(tags, list) or not all(isinstance(t, str) for t in tags): raise TypeError("tags must be a list of strings") # Escape all user-supplied content to prevent XSS safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=False) # Build tag spans tag_spans = [] for t in tags: safe_tag = html.escape(t, quote=True) tag_spans.append(f'{safe_tag}') tags_html = ' '.join(tag_spans) # Format the final HTML return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, post_title=safe_title, post_body=safe_body, tags_html=tags_html )
